sections.title: Introduction
sections.extract: In this paper we construct a new family {HN}, indexed by the odd integers N ≥1, of (2 + 1)- dimensional quantum ﬁeld theories (QFT) that we call Quantum Hyperbolic Field Theories (QHFT). Here, following [2, 30], by QFT we mean a functor from a (2 + 1)-bordism category, possibly non purely topological, to the tensorial category of ﬁnite dimensional complex linear spaces.
